summary.markdown: Acme Robotics kicked off a 4-week gateway POC. **Jane Doe** confirmed the cluster runs Kubernetes 1.3 and asked for per-team LLM budgets. Next check-in is next week.

transcriptSegments.speaker: Jane Doe
transcriptSegments.text: Thanks for making time. We want to start the gateway POC this week.

transcriptSegments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
transcriptSegments.text: Great. Before anything else, which Kubernetes version are the POC clusters on?

transcriptSegments.speaker: Jane Doe
transcriptSegments.text: One thirty-three on the POC clusters. Production is still on one thirty-one, and Sam owns that upgrade.

transcriptSegments.speaker: Jane Doe
transcriptSegments.text: Jane asked me to raise budgets. We need a monthly LLM spend cap per team, not one global number.

transcriptSegments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
transcriptSegments.text: That works with per-key budgets. I will send a config that caps two teams separately by Friday.

transcriptSegments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
transcriptSegments.text: This is Sam. Production upgrade to one thirty-three is planned for November, not before.

transcriptSegments.speaker: Jane Doe
transcriptSegments.text: So POC success criteria are budgets per team and tool-level access control. Four weeks.
